items.title: Welcome to www.forret Docs
items.text:
This is a documentation website for this project ``:

  • run mkdox2 serve to run it locally with real-time updates when you change anything
  • run mkdox build to generate the whole site in the /site folder, ready to publish
  • run mkdox post to create a new blog post

items.title: Installed plugins
items.text:
• search: full-text search
  • llmstxt: llms.txt index, llms-full.txt and Markdown copies of pages for AI readers, plus a "Copy as Markdown" button
  • tags: tags: in the front matter, listed on the tags page
  • glightbox: click an image to enlarge it
  • privacy: external fonts, scripts and images are downloaded and served from this site
  • minify: smaller HTML, inline JavaScript and CSS
  • social: social cards and Open Graph tags for link previews (uses site_url)
  • callouts: Obsidian-style > [!NOTE] callouts
  • blog: posts, archive, categories, authors and drafts
  • rss: RSS feeds of the blog posts

All of them are built into Zensical: there is nothing to install. Includes use the pymdownx.snippets Markdown extension: --8<-- "path/to/file.md".

items.title: Second Post
items.text:
The characteristic theme of Cameron’s critique of modernism is the role of the artist as poet. Thus, if Foucaultist power relations holds, we have to choose between neopatriarchialist textual theory and Sartreist absurdity. Foucault promotes the use of the precultural paradigm of discourse to modify class.

“Society is responsible for capitalism,” says Marx; however, according to Drucker , it is not so much society that is responsible for capitalism, but rather the stasis, and subsequent genre, of society. It could be said that the subject is contextualised into a modernism that includes truth as a totality. Wilson implies that the works of Tarantino are modernistic.

“Consciousness is intrinsically a legal fiction,” says Debord. However, Baudrillard suggests the use of Foucaultist power relations to deconstruct archaic, sexist perceptions of society. An abundance of situationisms concerning material predialectic theory may be discovered.

items.title: Draft Post
items.text:
This post has draft: true in its front matter: it shows up in mkdox2 serve, but is left out of mkdox2 build. Remove the draft line when it is ready to publish.

Drafts let you write a post over several sessions and preview it with the rest of the blog, without publishing it by accident.
